description.narrative:
This programme seeks to provide technical assistance for the formation of OTC Securities Exchange in Kenya:
• Support the structure and model of the OTC Securities Exchange. Involves setting up a project steering committee, hiring a project manager, design of a business plan and development of the OTC rules.
• Mobilization of capital for the exchange
• Registration and licensing of the OTC Securities Exchange. Involves the incorporation of the exchange and setting up governance and shareholding structure, membership subscription, organisation structure, management team, location and facilities.
• Operationalisation of the exchange which will see development and institutional capacity strengthening of the newly established exchange. Identification and lobbying the removal of regulatory obstacles which impede the participation of investors in the market.
